title: Bandit Elimination
description: The merchants have paid the Guild to end the raids out of the eastern outpost, and the contract Vorn hands you says eliminate - permanently, in writing, because that is what the merchants asked for and the merchants are the ones paying. Vorn will read the contract to you and then look at you for slightly too long. The raids stopping is what he is actually being measured on.

fulfil_the_contract.description: End the raids out of the eastern outpost

objectives.description: Find the outpost the raiders work out of
Take the outpost apart and kill the captain, as written
Bring the captain back alive for the merchants to hang themselves
Take the captain alone and quietly, and let the crew scatter
Warn the crew, take their purse, and tell Vorn they had already moved on

notes: Second multi-path showcase, and the counterpart to the Millbrook flagship: Millbrook is a hamlet asking a stranger for help, this is an employer handing over a contract with a word in it he is hoping you will interpret. Four roads in one OR group. locate_camp and killed_the_captain pre-complete off world facts the eastern outpost writes, so a player who cleared it before taking the contract gets paid on the spot. Old objective 'kill 8 bandits' dropped - it forced the assault road onto every path. locate_camp repointed from crossroads_bandit_camp, which has never existed, to bandit_camp_east, which does.
